plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Cisco wireless device. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, interface traffic, and wireless clients/radio (enterprise PEN 9).
name: Wireless

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the wireless controller since the last restart, derived from sysUpTime. Monitoring uptime helps administrators understand device stability and identify unexpected reboots.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilization of the Cisco wireless LAN controller. AireOS reports agentCurrentCPUUtilization as a 0-100 percentage; Catalyst 9800 falls back to the CISCO-PROCESS-MIB 5-minute average (cpmCPUTotal5minRev). Sustained high CPU usage can indicate heavy AP or client-management load affecting roaming and controller responsiveness.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Total controller memory in bytes. AireOS uses agentTotalMemory (KBytes × 1024); Catalyst 9800 derives total from CISCO-PROCESS-MIB CPU-wide used plus free memory (KBytes × 1024).

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: Free controller memory in bytes (KBytes × 1024). AireOS uses agentFreeMemory; Catalyst 9800 uses CISCO-PROCESS-MIB cpmCPUMemoryFree.

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: Used controller memory in bytes. AireOS derives used as agentTotalMemory − agentFreeMemory (KBytes × 1024); Catalyst 9800 uses CISCO-PROCESS-MIB cpmCPUMemoryUsed (KBytes × 1024).

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.query: (100 * (avg(snmp_device_memory_total{instance_type='wireless', __$labels__}) by (instance_id) - avg(snmp_device_memory_free{instance_type='wireless', __$labels__}) by (instance_id)) / avg(snmp_device_memory_total{instance_type='wireless', __$labels__}) by (instance_id)) or (100 * avg(device_memory_used{instance_type='wireless', __$labels__}) by (instance_id) / (avg(device_memory_used{instance_type='wireless', __$labels__}) by (instance_id) + avg(device_memory_free{instance_type='wireless', __$labels__}) by (instance_id)))
metrics.description: Memory utilization of the Cisco wireless LAN controller. AireOS is 100 × (total − free) / total; Catalyst 9800 is 100 × used / (used + free). High memory pressure can affect AP join handling and client roaming.

metrics.name: wireless_ap_count
metrics.description: Number of access points currently connected to the wireless LAN controller (cLApGlobalAPConnectCount). A sudden drop can indicate AP connectivity loss or a controller failover.
